sentences.text: Shanyangosaurus is a genus of theropod dinosaur.
The bones of this animal are reportedly hollow.
Fossils were found in Shaanxi, China, and the species was described by Xue et al. in 1996.
The known remains consist of a partial sacrum, scapula, humeri, femur, tibia, metatarsals, and phalanges.
Features of the femur and foot bones suggest Shanyangosaurus was a member of the Coelurosauria.
Holtz et al. assigned Shanyangosaurus to the Avetheropoda, which is its parent group.
Shanyangosaurus lived during the Maastrichtian age in the Shanyang Formation, between 72.2 and 66 million years ago.
